source.flyway: V1 through V20, applied unmodified to a disposable empty MySQL 8.0 database

exportPrerequisites: Node 24, mysql2, mongoexport, mongosh; Wrangler available to import through the workspace dependency
MYSQL_URL, MONGO_URI, MONGO_DATABASE, REDIS_URL supplied only at execution, never committed
All Java/API/background writers stopped across all three stores; SCAN is not an atomic Redis snapshot
Redis ACL permits SCAN, TYPE, per-type reads, TIME, PTTL, and the included EVAL script containing only TIME/PTTL reads; expiry uses Redis server time, not workstation time
Live Flyway V20 successful and all 165 table names, column types/nullability/defaults/collations/generated expressions, indexes, CHECK constraints and foreign keys match source metadata
Actual JVM/JDBC DATETIME timezone offset established independently; +09:00 shown in command is an example, not an inferred production setting
No application traffic on the newly created D1 target until import manifest verification succeeds

representations.int: INTEGER with integer storage class and exact signed/unsigned source ranges; ordinary IDs remain JavaScript numbers
representations.bigint: Canonical signed 64-bit decimal TEXT, checked through exact SQLite CAST roundtrip; numeric predicates and ordering require CAST(column AS INTEGER), IDs are never coerced through JavaScript Number
representations.bigintAutoIncrement: notification and notification_subscribe use native_sequence, allocated by allocateBigintId and initialized to imported maximum; gaps on failed business operations are allowed as in MySQL
representations.decimal: Exact decimal TEXT; exporter refuses numeric JSON conversion, scale and range checked
representations.binary16: Canonical lowercase UUID TEXT, exact 16-byte binary conversion
representations.binaryOther: BLOB/Uint8Array, base64 in export envelopes and hex SQL literals
representations.json: Original MySQL JSON text retained byte-for-byte after syntax validation; JSON_VALID enforced; Drizzle JSON mapping is used only for actual source JSON columns
representations.timestamp: UTC SQL datetime text; fractional source digits preserved
representations.datetime: Declared source timezone shifted to UTC SQL text, except new_koreatech_articles.registered_at, which is a LocalDate calendar value
representations.mongoDatetime: ISO UTC for chat instants; citybus_timetables.updated_at preserves source local calendar display semantics
representations.nativeExpiry: Owner-defined SQL UTC/ISO UTC text or integer epoch milliseconds, encoded explicitly by native-schema.mjs
representations.onUpdate: SQLite AFTER UPDATE triggers update source ON UPDATE columns only when other values change and timestamp value is unchanged; SQLite cannot distinguish explicitly reassigning the same old timestamp from omitting that column

collation.sql: Source *_ci columns use actual SQLite NOCASE in both DDL and Drizzle custom types; this supports only ASCII folding, not arbitrary MySQL Unicode equality
collation.storage: native_collation_key has PRIMARY KEY(scope,owner) and UNIQUE(scope,normalized). Original display text stays unchanged. Converter populates every applicable source unique index. Runtime normalizedUniqueWrites must be in the same atomic batch as writes; normalizedUniqueLookup queries the registry
collation.normalization: PAD SPACE for non0900 collations; general_ci uses NFD, other *_ci uses NFKD; lowercase plus combining-mark removal; final-sigma folding; general_ci sharp-s to s, Unicode sharp-s to ss; oe-ligature folding outside general_ci; ae/stroked-l/stroked-d/slashed-o folding only for0900
collation.limits: This is an explicit approximation, not MySQL UCA4/UCA9/general_ci weight tables. Context-sensitive contractions, all-script case/mark equivalences, compatibility characters and utf8mb3 supplementary-character restrictions are not fully reproduced. SQL LIKE/equality/sorts remain SQLite semantics unless a domain uses normalized lookup. Imported normalization collisions fail closed; operator must reconcile, never silently merge

importSafety.checkpoint: SHA256/byte/count manifest per source file; complete=false on interruption. Export cannot resume an old consistent snapshot: start a new empty output directory. Converted D1 files commit a native_import_checkpoint row with data hash and count; importer resumes only identical checkpoints
importSafety.foreignKeys: Local staging preserves all source constraints, validates PRAGMA foreign_key_check and integrity_check, and emits topologically ordered strongly connected FK components with deferred enforcement; final D1 counts and foreign keys checked again
importSafety.limits: Reject database above 10000000000 bytes, rows above 2MiB including conservative record-header allowance, SQL statements above100000 bytes, or an indivisible FK-component import file above5GiB. No data is truncated or silently omitted
importSafety.redis: Original binary values retained losslessly in native_legacy_redis. Explicit adapters map active business keys; unknown live keyspaces block conversion. Expired values, Spring secondary indexes/shadow copies, obsolete dining notification cache and disconnected socket presence are archived with a declared disposition
importSafety.chat: Reconcile Mongo embedded messages and Redis zsets by decimal TSID; read/deleted flags merge monotonically, richer submillisecond timestamps survive Mongo millisecond truncation, conflicting content/identity/image values block conversion
importSafety.payment: Temporary payment import rebuilds and freezes the current cart graph, requires exact original product/total money equality, retains real PTTL, and blocks if mutable source cart no longer matches
importSafety.mongoArchive: Every original canonical Extended JSON document is also retained in native_legacy_mongo, including historical/unknown fields; no selected-column transform discards source data
importSafety.search: new_articles title bigrams backfilled using the exact domain NFC/lowercase/codepoint/stopword algorithm; ongoing title writes replace their index atomically in the community domain
